email.body1:
Connor, saw Orum ship the new AI Dialer and the 2026 State of Sales Development Report.

Growing the install base usually surfaces more in-market revenue teams than a growth-sales team can personally reach before the quarter closes. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Orum off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Connor, quick follow-up for Orum.

You know better than most that the dialer fills the top of funnel, but coverage still breaks when there are more accounts in play than reps can research and follow up on. That is exactly the gap that shows up late in a growth quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Orum needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Connor, last bit of proof for Orum.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Orum's reply rate likely compares to peer sales-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Connor, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Growth sales keeps a team busy, and timing matters more than any pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to a growth-sales motion? I'll tailor it to Orum either way.
